Beff’s story has been in the making for a long time.
While you waited, we were working not just on a functional game, but on creating an experience you’ll remember.
We know we asked you to wait a little longer.
But every moment of that wait was dedicated to making Beff’s world bigger, more fun, and more unforgettable.

Today, we’re thrilled to finally share the full version of Beff Jezos Simulator with you.
Along the way, we didn’t just fix bugs; we added new systems and content to make the game deeper, richer, and far more enjoyable.
And now… the gates to your e-commerce empire are wide open!

💾 MULTIPLE SAVE SLOTS

Every corner can carry your personal touch.

With optimized gameplay, improved systems, and richer content, Beff Jezos Simulator invites you to an intense journey to the top.
We made you wait a bit — but we know it was worth it for a better experience.



Beff Jezos Simulator is now in full release.

notes.title: Update v1.08 - New Box Dimensions
notes.notes:
📦 Two Exciting Updates Are Here!
Hello, dear players!
We are thrilled to bring you two new features to enhance your gameplay experience. Here are the details:

✨ 1st Update: Different Box Sizes
Now you can ship your products using different box sizes! Instead of being limited to a single box size, you can now work with three options:

 Small Box: Perfect for smaller products.
 Medium Box: Ideal for standard products.
 Large Box: Ready for big orders.


🎮 How to Use?

 Click on the box icon on the right to select the desired box size.
 Use keyboard shortcuts for quick access:
 Press 1 for a small box, 2 for a medium box, and 3 for a large box.
 You can also customize the box selection panel via the Settings menu.


✨ 2nd Update: Worker Automation
Your worker can now prepare incoming orders for you!

🎮 How Does It Work?

 Activate the “Worker Automation” feature on the left side of the Orders screen.
 Once activated, your worker will automatically accept and prepare orders up to their capacity, then move on to the next.
 While this feature is active, you can still take over any unclaimed orders manually.


📋 If Deactivated?
If the feature is turned off, any orders left by the worker will be assigned to you, just like before.
